rules.reason: Handlers submit validated requests through Sessions; Maps owns map state and its systems.
rules.repair: Submit through the session boundary instead of referencing a Maps type or member directly; hand product changes to the owning part.

rules.reason: Map state/simulation does not depend on incoming packet handlers; existing Maps to Sessions sending is allowed.
rules.repair: Keep packet request handling outside Maps and retain Maps to Sessions sending; hand product changes to the owning part.

rules.reason: Sessions dispatches via the exact registry/interface contract, without depending on concrete handlers.
rules.repair: Use the existing HandlerRegistry/IPacketHandler dispatcher contract instead of concrete handlers; hand product changes to the owning part.

occurrenceUnit: One resolved original type/member per syntax span and target declaration, per rule; repeated lexical uses count separately, identical observations are deduplicated.
exclusions: bin/obj and generated .g.cs/.generated.cs boundary files; generated project inputs still participate in compilation
Namespaces alone, comments, strings and inactive preprocessor branches are not compiled references
Only original type/member declarations inside the three areas enter the reference list; external/other-area targets are excluded, and same-area references are allowed
Reflection/dynamic runtime targets and actor/tick safety are outside this static check
Areas are physical declaration/source folders; moving code outside them changes classification and is a known limitation
